configurations.name: jobbylooky
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use >/dev/null && npm run build && MAIL_DATABASE_URL=http://192.168.42.180:8082 npm start

configurations.name: jobbylooky-sample
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use >/dev/null && npm run build && d=$(mktemp -d) && cp tests/fixtures/sample-inbox.json "$d/import.json" && DATA_DIR="$d" MAIL_SEND_MODE=preview PORT=4318 npm start

configurations.name: jobbylooky-copy
runtimeArgs: source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use >/dev/null && npm run build && d=$(mktemp -d) && cp data/opportunities.json "$d/" && DATA_DIR="$d" MAIL_SEND_MODE=preview PORT=4319 npm start

configurations.name: jobbylooky-chungus-copy
runtimeArgs: set -o pipefail && source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use >/dev/null && npm run build && d=$(mktemp -d) && ssh chungus 'docker exec jobbylooky tar -C /app/data -cf - opportunities.json voicemails.json voicemail-audio link-checks.json' | tar -C "$d" -xf - && DATA_DIR="$d" MAIL_SEND_MODE=preview PORT=4320 npm start
